_about: Gate P8: every file in wp-content/mu-plugins must be listed here by exact filename with an approved SHA-256 and its provenance. Anything else (a new host file, a changed checksum, a leftover test harness) fails the gate until it is reviewed and recorded here. Add new checksums only after reading the file.
